name: Orthodontist

pf.license.need: each orthodontist holds their own license from the state's dental board; an orthodontic assistant holds one only where the state licenses assistants
pf.license.who: each person; the practice too where the state's form registers dental offices or their owners
pf.license.ask: each person's license number in their invite reply, or the owner sends it; the practice's registration and any mobile permit number come from the owner. The owner may leave a number out
pf.license.check: Rosie does not look up, check or verify a license number. The owner gives it, and it is shown where the state asks
pf.license.blocks: no booking is held or refused because of a license: the owner states it, and that is the record
pf.license.away: visits at a care home, a school or a home only where the state's rules allow mobile or portable orthodontic work; a mobile or portable dental permit where the state's form asks for one (a switch)
pf.license.sedation: no sedation: the example office does none, so Rosie never offers it
pf.license.agreement: a health privacy agreement (a HIPAA business associate agreement) signed on the secure page before the first booking; every company in Rosie's chain signs one with Rosie
pf.license.renewals: if the owner records an expiry date, Rosie reminds the owner 30 days before it; Rosie does not check the license
pf.license.insurance: malpractice insurance where the state's form asks for it; the owner states it, and Rosie does not check it

pf.services.shape: visit types in a chair, each with a set length; a braces start is a bonding visit, then set adjustment visits; an emergency fix is booked the same day with the owner's OK; every visit needs a free chair
pf.services.examples: the example offices' own prices (Lee Orthodontics and Lee Mobile Braces), not a standard; a plan pays its own share for braces, up to its yearly limit, and the patient's share is an estimate

list.name: New patient check (X-rays and photos, then the orthodontist's exam)
list.kind: one price; the plan's estimate is shown when a plan pays
list.length: 60 min: 30 with the assistant (X-rays, photos, the bite), then 30 with the orthodontist
list.after: the patient's share at the front desk
list.note: new-patient times are kept apart (Sam's booking rules)

list.name: Braces (full treatment, child, teen or adult)
list.price: $5,500 for the whole treatment (the example office's price)
list.kind: one price for the whole treatment, paid in parts
list.length: 90 min for the bonding visit, then set adjustment visits
list.before: a $500 deposit when starting, or the whole price paid in one payment
list.after: the rest at the front desk, in parts at the visits
list.note: a signed treatment agreement on the secure page first; no monthly charge on a card

list.name: Monthly adjustment (wire or braces check)
list.note: part of the braces treatment, booked as a set visit

list.name: Retainer repair, quoted from photos
list.price: $90 (the example office's price, quoted from photos first)
list.length: 2 visits: the photos, then the fitting
list.before: a $20 deposit once the orthodontist's quote is OK'd
list.after: the rest ($70) at the front desk, at the visit
list.note: the orthodontist OKs the quote and the price is shown before any deposit

list.name: Broken bracket or poking wire (emergency visit)
list.price: the $25 check is promised; any repair is priced at the chair (the example: $110 in all)
list.note: the owner OKs same-day times first

list.name: Retainer (new one, made from the scan)
list.note: for a lost or broken retainer after treatment; a plan may not pay it

list.name: Braces check and retainer fitting
list.kind: one price, paid in full when booked

list.name: Braces check at a care home
list.kind: one price; the plan's share when a plan pays
list.where: at the customer's place (a care home or a home)
list.before: nothing taken when a plan pays; private pay gets Rosfield's bill after the visit
list.after: the office bills the plan its own way; private pay: Rosie texts the bill

list.name: Broken bracket or poking wire at a care home
list.price: the $89 visit fee is promised; any repair is priced at the visit (the example: $245 in all)

list.name: New retainer, quoted from the care-home scan
list.price: $640 (the example office's price, quoted from photos first)
list.length: 3 visits: the scan, the fitting, the delivery
list.before: a $160 deposit when the quote is OK'd (25%)
list.after: Rosie texts the bill for the $480 rest when the orthodontist texts DONE

list.name: School orthodontic screening day
list.price: set with the school: free to families, or billed to each child's plan
list.length: a whole morning, one portable kit
list.after: the office bills plans its own way
list.note: each child needs a parent's or guardian's signed consent on the secure page

pf.services.capacity: one patient per chair; the office's chairs and the portable kit are booked like people
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the patient is always there
pf.services.online: none: a braces check or a fitting needs the chair; a question by video is answered by the office, not booked as a visit

beforeTimes: for you, your child, or someone you help (a care home resident)
which visit: the office's own visit types only (a new patient check, braces, clear aligners, a retainer, or an emergency visit), never a symptom typed into the AI
a dental or orthodontic plan (its name only) or paying yourself
afterTime: anything the office should know to help, like a wheelchair or needing an interpreter
for a care home or school visit: the place's name, the room, and who meets the orthodontist
securePage: plan member ID, the plan holder and a photo of the plan card
health history: medicines, allergies and conditions
a parent's or guardian's consent for anyone under 18, or the consent of the person who decides for an adult who can't
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult for themselves; a parent or guardian for anyone under 18; a guardian or health care agent for an adult who can't consent; the care home's staff for a resident, with the decider's consent on the secure page; a minor alone only where the state's rules let minors consent to orthodontic care (a switch)
pf.questions.neverAsked: symptoms, reasons or results are never asked or typed in the AI chat

stop.words: face or jaw swelling with a fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing
stop.say: This needs care now. Go to the nearest emergency room or call 911. Don't wait for an orthodontic visit.
stop.booking: no booking; the same words are repeated if a same-day request is declined

stop.words: a tooth knocked loose or out, or bleeding that won't stop
stop.say: Call the office's own line now, or go to the emergency room. Keep a tooth that came out in milk.
stop.booking: no booking by the AI; the office's own line

stop.words: swallowed something poisonous, or too much of a medicine
stop.say: Call Poison Help now at 1-800-222-1222, or 911 if they're not awake or not breathing.

goOn.words: a poking wire, a loose bracket or a sore mouth with nothing else
goOn.what: matched to the office's own emergency visit; Rosie never judges how urgent it is

pf.safety.always: the general screen: danger to life, fire, gas or a medical emergency gets 911, and words about self-harm get 988

steps.name: Health history, consent and the plan's papers
steps.when: on the secure page only, never by text; due the day before the visit (a same-day visit: before the time is held); one reminder before it's due
steps.who: every new patient; returning patients once a year, or when their health changes
steps.result: not done by its due date: Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page at the desk or the door, before any work), moves it, or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The plan check
steps.when: while booking, by the front desk, by hand
steps.who: every patient who names a plan
steps.result: covered, some services only, not covered, or can't check now (the desk checks later, and the patient may cancel free)

steps.name: A written price estimate for self-pay patients
steps.when: told while booking; sent within 1 business day (the example office's rule), or sooner where the rules require it
steps.result: a to-do for the front desk, with its due date

steps.name: A signed treatment agreement for braces or aligners
steps.when: on the secure page, before the bonding visit, with the price and the parts shown first
steps.who: every braces or aligner patient, and the parent or guardian for a child
steps.result: not signed by the bonding visit: the visit waits; Sam moves it or cancels with no fee

steps.name: The care home's OK
steps.who: the host place agrees to host the visits
steps.result: no OK: no times at that place

pf.first_steps.prep: arrive 15 minutes early; bring a photo ID and the plan card; at a care home: the resident's medicine list ready with the nurse

pf.visit.checkIn: at the office: the check-in code at the front desk; at a care home or school: the code from the patient, or from the nurse or staff member named on the booking
pf.visit.beforeWork: the orthodontic assistant takes the X-rays and photos first; the orthodontist reads the health history and checks for changes before any work
pf.visit.changes: a broken bracket or a wire fix is priced and OK'd before it's done; the plan's estimate is shown first; a new step (a spacer, a bonding, a new wire) is booked as its own visit only with the patient's yes
pf.visit.done: the check-in code or DONE; the orthodontist's notes, X-rays and photos stay in the office's own records, never in Rosie or a text
pf.visit.away: a portable kit (a light, a chair, a camera); the care home's nurse is told when the visit is done

pf.money.before: nothing taken at booking for a new patient check or a braces check (the office bills dental and orthodontic plans); a card saved only where the office turns on its missed-visit fee; braces or clear aligners: a $500 deposit when starting, or the whole price in one payment; a retainer repair from photos: a $20 deposit once the quote is OK'd; at a care home: nothing taken when a plan pays, a $160 deposit for a new retainer from the scan, the rest on Rosfield's bill
pf.money.plans: the plans the office takes (its own list); the front desk checks each plan by hand and records it: active or not, what it pays for braces and up to what yearly limit; the patient's share is an estimate, not a promise
pf.money.selfPay: a self-pay patient is told while booking that they can get a written price estimate, and gets it on time; a bill far above it can be disputed (the federal rules set how)
pf.money.fees: the missed-visit fee: $20 at the example office, only when the owner turns it on; a card is saved for it, and the same fee applies to every patient who may be charged one
pf.money.feeFree: a switch: no fee ever for patients whose plan or the state's rules bar one (like Medicaid, where that applies), or whom the owner marks fee-free; their texts say 'No fee to cancel or miss'
pf.money.after: claims sent by the office; the patient pays their share at the front desk, its own way; braces are paid in parts at the front desk over the visits, never charged by Rosie on a set day; a balance after the plan pays is billed by the office, not by Rosie's text; at a care home, the office bills its own way
pf.money.rosfield: the business pays Rosfield's $2 per confirmed booking, as every business does (the $2 is counted when the visit's check-in code is entered; no visit, no $2); card payments also cost Stripe's own card fee
pf.money.caps: deposit cap: from the state form; fee limits for plan patients: from the plan's and the state's rules

pf.messages.never: texts carry only the practice's name, the date, the time, the address and a secure link: never the visit type, the plan, the reason, the results or the orthodontist's name (when the orthodontist comes to a care home, school or home, the name stays, for the door check); X-rays and photos never go through Rosie
pf.messages.staff: texts to the owner and staff use the patient's initials only (A.M., never Alex M.)
pf.messages.minors: a minor's texts go to the parent or guardian; a minor who may consent alone gets texts only on their own phone, with no visit type
pf.messages.decider: for an adult who can't consent, the texts go to the person who decides, and the code to whoever meets the orthodontist

pf.staff.licenses: each orthodontist's own license, per state; an orthodontic assistant's own license only where the state licenses assistants
pf.staff.skills: orthodontists: exams, braces, clear aligners, retainers and emergency fixes; orthodontic assistants: X-rays, photos, and the bracket and wire work the state allows; only people cleared for mobile visits go to care homes and schools
pf.staff.supervision: an assistant works only while the orthodontist is in the office or on the portable visit, as the state's rules allow (a switch: some states let assistants work alone at schools and care homes)
pf.staff.oks: the owner OKs same-day emergency times, braces or aligner quotes over $500, and anything an assistant flags
pf.staff.standIn: an assistant out: the orthodontist does the fitting, or new times; the orthodontist out: another orthodontist takes the visit, or new times with no fee
pf.staff.away: the team at a care home or school is the people cleared for mobile visits, with the portable kit

pf.rules.records: orthodontic records are kept by the office for as long as the state's rules require (a child's records may be kept longer); a delete request removes only Rosie's own booking details, never the office's records
pf.rules.copies: a patient's copy of their records within the time the rules set; Rosie sends only booking and payment records
pf.rules.showLicense: the license shown where the state asks: posted at the office, and on a visit away from it
pf.rules.minors: who may consent for a minor, and at what age a minor may consent alone (a switch from the state form)
pf.rules.host: a visit at a care home or school only under the host's written OK, and the host's sign-in rules; visit days at a host's place (S1-58) need the host's standing OK on file; the example's care home visits are booked one resident at a time under the care home's OK, so no visit days are set
pf.rules.ads: no free-consult or price claims the state's rules don't allow
pf.rules.privacy: health privacy rules for every message and form

pf.edges.lateArrival: more than 15 minutes late: still seen, but part of the visit may move to another day (the office decides; Rosie never changes the booking itself)
pf.edges.standIn: an orthodontist or assistant out: a stand-in who may do that part, or new times with no fee
pf.edges.forms: a form not done by its due date: one reminder, then Sam keeps the visit (signed on the secure page before any work), moves it, or cancels with no fee (A7-74, B7-61)
pf.edges.planChange: the plan check comes back not covered: self-pay, or a free cancel
pf.edges.twoBookings: a patient with a treatment visit and a check both open: Rosie asks which one before any change
pf.edges.healthQuestion: a question about medicine or care before the visit goes to the orthodontist; Rosie gives no advice
pf.edges.careHome: the resident is out (at the hospital, or asleep): the nurse says so, and the visit moves with no fee
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way
pf.edges.urgent: no service is sent now and nobody is on call (S2-30, S2-31): a broken bracket or a poking wire gets the soonest same-day time, with the owner's OK; swelling with a fever, or trouble breathing or swallowing, gets the 911 words

notes: Start: the dentist (clinic), refitted Oct 27. Names: Sam Lee, an orthodontist, owns Lee Mobile Braces LLC (the master's main company: mobile orthodontics at schools and care homes, 75 Mill Rd) and Lee Orthodontics LLC (the second company: the office, 410 Harbor Ave). Flow A is at the office; flow B at Riverside care home, 64 Linden Rd, where Alex lives. Staff: Nina (orthodontist) and Owen (assistant) at the office; Priya (orthodontist) and Ben (assistant) on the mobile team. Prices keep the master's own numbers where its examples add up: check $35, fee $20, retainer $140, care-home check $179, care-home visit fee $89, new retainer $150 with a $40 deposit. Braces ($5,500, a $500 deposit or one payment) and clear aligners are new example prices. The $2 applies (D97): the 'No $2' branch of S1-62 is off, and no no2 switch is set. Licenses are optional and never checked (D96). Health work: sensitive on, so no rating is asked (A10-34 / B10-32 stay on the no-rating branch).
